Agency, Sunblast /Saul Solis, Bicep/Vittorio Stobillio, G-Lo/Gloria Grentina, Bulldozer/Robert Debuilder, Ringworm/Jordan Edmund, El Valiente/Pedro Rodriguez Villa, Commander Airlock / Amanda Hamilton Weaver, and Miss Heed/Cecilia Amanda Kelly, but little they all of them know that SCP-XXXX “The Invincible Ranger”, Object Class: Safe, Special Containment Procedures: SCP-XXXX is to be contained within a specially constructed containment cell made of reinforced obsidian walls, located within Site-███. The containment cell must be equipped with multiple redundant power generators capable of providing a minimum of ███,███ volts of electricity. The cell should also be equipped with surveillance cameras for constant monitoring of SCP-XXXX’s activities. Any attempts by SCP-XXXX to communicate with personnel are to be treated as a potential SCP-XXXX mental manipulation effect and ignored. Description: SCP-XXXX is an individual identified as Tommy Oliver, formerly known as the Green Ranger, White Ranger, Red Zeo Ranger, Turbo Red Ranger, and Dino Thunder Black Ranger in various iterations of the Power Rangers media franchise. SCP-XXXX displays a variety of anomalous abilities and attributes, as well as an unparalleled talent for verbal combat and clever comebacks. In addition to its exceptional verbal skills, SCP-XXXX possesses an extensive array of superhuman abilities, including atomic pulse emission, magnetism manipulation, precognition, fireball projection, electric biting, superhuman speed, strength, and senses, laser beam emission, teleportation, powerful jaws, enormous size, fast climbing, gravity beam projection, nuclear/atomic bomb/pulse emission, radioactive heat ray projection, asymmetrically permeable shield, obsidian hardening, and more. SCP-XXXX has been observed demonstrating these abilities both independently and in conjunction with its verbal combat skills. These abilities, when combined with SCP-XXXX’s seemingly limitless endurance, healing factor, and near-invulnerability, make it highly difficult to subdue or contain. SCP-XXXX has shown the ability to withstand attacks from conventional weaponry and SCP objects without any notable effect. SCP-XXXX’s mental manipulation abilities have been observed in situations where it can twist conversations to its advantage, leaving opponents at a loss for words. SCP-XXXX has also been reported to possess an exceptionally high intelligence level, utilizing its keen wit and clever comebacks in verbal altercations, often reducing opponents to silence or some form of psychological defeat. It is currently unknown how SCP-XXXX acquired its abilities or why it possesses such a wide range of anomalous powers. Investigations into SCP-XXXX’s origins and potential weaknesses are ongoing. It is recommended that personnel exercise utmost caution when interacting with SCP-XXXX, as its mental manipulation abilities and physical capabilities pose a significant risk to containment protocols and personnel safety. Addendum: Dr. ██████’s Note: SCP-XXXX’s abilities and attributes seem vastly overpowered and may require revision to appropriately bring the subject under control. Additionally, its clever and witty comebacks have led to several incidents of morale depletion among personnel. Further research is necessary to understand the full extent of SCP-XXXX’s capabilities and vulnerabilities, Black Hat: The founder, leader, and most powerful villain of the Black Hat Organization. He is an ancient shape-shifting eldritch being with a top hat and monocle, known for his malicious and sadistic nature, Dr. Flug Slys: Black Hat’s brilliant, but nervous and easily frightened scientist. He is responsible for creating various evil inventions and gadgets for the organization, Demencia: A wild and unpredictable member of the Black Hat Organization. She has a short temper, superhuman strength, and is highly energetic, making her a formidable force, 5.0.5: A failed experiment at the Black Hat Organization, 5.0.5 is a large and friendly bear who unintentionally causes chaos due to his uncontrollable appetite, Penumbra is a middle-aged woman with long silver hair and a stern expression. She is a serious and business-oriented character, hired by Black Hat Organization (B.H.O.) as a client. Penumbra is often seen wearing a formal black suit with a red tie. She is determined and focused on achieving her goals, willing to seek help from villains to accomplish her missions, Metauro is a large, muscular man with a bull-like head and mechanical hooves instead of feet. He has a short temper and a tendency to charge into situations without thinking. Despite his aggressive demeanor, Metauro is not particularly smart and often falls prey to Black Hat’s schemes without realizing it, The Ghost Children are a group of spooky and mischievous spirits. They are depicted as young boys and girls wearing tattered clothes and possessing translucent appearances. These characters have a fascination for causing mayhem and create chaos wherever they go. While they can be mischievous, the Ghost Children often find themselves outsmarted by Black Hat and his team, Adelita Guerrero is a dynamic and rebellious character. She is depicted as a young girl with short black hair, a punk aesthetic, and a fiery attitude. Adelita is associated with the Mexican Day of the Dead aesthetic and possesses the ability to manipulate skeletal structures. She often seeks Black Hat’s assistance in her personal vendettas against her enemies, and V.I.R.U.S. stands for Vile Inborn Rats Under Siege. V.I.R.U.S. is a monstrous computer virus with a unique personality. It has a predatory nature and enjoys infecting computer systems to cause chaos and destruction. V.I.R.U.S. has a sinister, robotic voice and a twisted sense of humor. It is one of Black Hat’s more complex clients who often brings trouble wherever it goes, and the P.E.A.C.E.
